archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST mixed with THE TRACING BEAM (Apple/Stripe/Linear style)

fonts.purpose: Body text, UI elements, buttons, standard data
Terminal UI, code snippets, live numbers/metrics

rules: CRITICAL: Headings MUST use DM Serif Display. Do NOT use Inter for main headings.
Headlines > 32px must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Terminal and metric numbers must use JetBrains Mono.
NO massive colorful gradients. Stick to deep navy/black.
Electric blue (#2563EB) is for primary CTAs and active states.
Subtle green (#10B981) is for positive terminal outputs, success metrics, and 'running' statuses.

visual_enhancers.hero_background: Implement a pure CSS animated grid background. Use `bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:24px_24px]`. Overlay with a radial-gradient mask-image to fade it out at the edges.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky nav and overlays: `bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5`. MUST NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use VERY subtle box shadows for highlighted elements (e.g., `shadow-[0_0_40px_-15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.3)]`). No harsh neon.
visual_enhancers.noise: Add a fixed `pointer-events-none` <div> with a subtle SVG noise filter overlay (opacity 0.03) to break digital flatness.

layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. Use `py-24` or `py-32` for sections. `gap-8` or `gap-12` in bento grids.
layouts.grid_bento: Problem & Capabilities sections must use asymmetric Bento grids (e.g., span-8, span-4, span-7, span-5) to create tension.
layouts.container: Use `max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6` for standard sections. DO NOT center-align all text; left-align content blocks for a technical feel.

components.hero_section: Asymmetric layout. Left: Headline ('Your business. Running itself.'), subtext, two pill-shaped CTAs (Primary blue, Secondary outline). Right: Floating Abstract tech metrics or mini-dashboard widgets.
components.problem_cards: 3 tall bento cards. Deep slate backgrounds (`bg-slate-900/50`), 1px `border-slate-800`. Hover effect: gentle lift and border brightens to slate-600.
components.terminal_ui: A window block with Mac-like dots in the top-left (red, yellow, green). Inside: JetBrains Mono text. `quantro execute --strategy aggressive` -> returns success logs in green. Typing animation using framer-motion or standard CSS steps.
components.capabilities_grid: 4 bento cards. Mix of square and wide rectangular shapes. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
components.product_preview: A 'High Density Grid' mockup. A large container styled as an app window. Inside: Sidebar (col-span-1), Main area (col-span-3) with KPI cards and a Recharts line chart.
components.differentiation_table: 3-column CSS grid table. The 'Quantro' column must have a subtle `bg-blue-900/10` background, electric blue top border, and glow to stand out against competitors.
components.investor_metrics: Grid of large numbers (JetBrains Mono) with small overlines (tracking-[0.2em]). E.g., '$5.2B TAM'.
components.pricing_tiers: 3 vertical cards. The 'Pro' card must be scaled up slightly (`scale-105`), have a border of `border-blue-500/50`, and a 'Most Popular' badge.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`). Primary: `bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white transition-all`. Secondary: `border border-slate-700 bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-800 text-white`.

animations.scroll: Use framer-motion for `whileInView` fade-ups (`y: 20, opacity: 0` to `y: 0, opacity: 1`) on section wrappers.
animations.hover: Interactive cards should translate-y-1 and increase border opacity. Subtle, enterprise-grade motion.
animations.terminal_typing: Use simple keyframe animation or Framer Motion for the command line typing effect in the Solution section.

media_and_icons.icons: lucide-react for all standard UI icons (Check, ArrowRight, BarChart, etc). Keep stroke-width to 1.5 for a premium feel.
media_and_icons.images: No specific stock photos needed. Rely on CSS-based UI mockups, terminal UI, and grid patterns to represent the 'SaaS' product. This creates the 'Linear/Stripe' look much better than generic stock images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on the #030712 background passes WCAG AAA. Secondary text (#94A3B8) must pass AA.
accessibility.interactive: All buttons/links MUST have focus-visible outlines (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Load DM Serif Display, Inter, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
Build the page as a single smooth-scrolling landing page.
Create custom layout structures using pure Tailwind grid/flexbox. Do NOT wrap entire sections in basic Shadcn Cards; use raw divs for maximum layout flexibility and overlap.
Implement the 'Product Preview' as a set of nested flex/grid divs to look like a real dashboard mockup, NOT a static image.
Implement the Terminal UI with absolute positioning for the 'Mac dots' and pure text for the code.
Ensure the hero background grid has a radial gradient mask so it fades to black at the edges, preventing a 'boxy' look.
Include a placeholder download button for the Investor Deck (`<a href='#' download>`).
Do NOT apply a global `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Do NOT center-align the main App container. Everything should be left-aligned or intentionally positioned.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all buttons, links, and forms for testing.
